issue.title: Border top-right and bottom-right doesn't render properly when using a wide rune
issue.body:
When I use a wide rune (e.g. "⏩") as a top-right or bottom-right corner, the resulting edge is wider than the other lines.

This should be corrected by padding the other lines.

See this example:

![Screenshot_2022-09-03_23-29-20](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/642886/188288231-585c5656-7c21-4360-956f-36f53a893581.png)

Found while working on #109.

cc @meowgorithm
